title: An inclusion into a quasi-coherent subobject is detected on an affine cover
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], F an O_X-module, and G <= H subobjects of F [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Assume H is quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent]. For any affine open cover (U_i), equality of the images of Gamma(U_i,G) and Gamma(U_i,H) in Gamma(U_i,F) implies G = H. The smaller subobject need not be quasi-coherent and the cover need not be finite.

source.place: exists_map_eq_pow_smul_of_isAffineOpen, used to formalize the local-to-global step in Stacks Tag 01Y8

proof.text: Use the subobject inequality to construct the inclusion phi:G -> H. Evaluation preserves monomorphisms, so phi and H -> F are injective on sections over each open. Equal section images make phi surjective over each U_i.

The basic opens D(f) in the U_i form a basis. For a section t of H over D(f), the denominator lemma supplies n and s in Gamma(U_i,H) restricting to f^n t. Lift s to G over U_i, restrict to D(f), and multiply by the inverse nth power of f, which is a unit in its basic-open section ring. Naturality makes this a preimage of t.

The sheaf morphism underlying phi is bijective on a basis. Mathlib TopCat.Sheaf.isIso_iff_isIso_basis makes it an isomorphism. The forgetful functor to abelian presheaves reflects isomorphisms. Apply Subobject.eq_of_comm to the isomorphism and the factorization through H -> F.
